title: BIG PROBLEM
body: Hello. I purchased the paid version of your app. I'm experiencing a major problem. For example, I create habit one, habit two, and habit three. Then I enter the daily results for each habit. Then, an hour later, I open the app again, and the results for these habits are reversed. That is, the results for habit one are somehow already displayed for habit three. I've already manually corrected these results once, but today I opened the app again, and I have eight habits created, with results for each habit. Today, for every single one of those eight habits, all the results are incorrect; they're randomly displayed and completely inaccurate. This serious error makes the app unusable; it's essentially nonfunctional because it's not fulfilling its primary function.
